narrative: The letter, open. The sheet has filled past her name. The hand is moving. Nothing is struck through. The letter, open. The next sentence is shorter than the line above it. The pen lifts. The letter, open. Mid-sheet. The brook sentence is in, and the two sentences after it. No house is named. The coffer is still shut at the edge of the frame.
